name: Midoriyama Chihiro
source:
One of the hero's classmates. A junior of Mieko Yamagiwa, a former Yankee like her.
Nowadays, she looks pretty and has a cute tone, but when she gets sharp, she is scarier than Mieko. My hobby is sports in general. She has recently gotten into surfing. She hasn't had a relationship with a man for the past few years, and Mieko suspects that she ran into a woman.

[from Getchu]
